caption:
Do you track what you eat? Comment YES or NO.

In WE.LIFE you tick off eaten meals in the plan and see your daily balance right away. No writing everything down on paper, and your meal plan shows what's still left.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.

#mealplan #healthyhabits #mealprep
